obraz: The bread comes hot from the oven, enough for everyone at the table.
text: The crumb steams where the loaf is torn, the part no one thinks to notice, Anna. Fehu is wealth that moves, warmth made to be handed round rather than hoarded. This is what you have now, hot and enough, meant for the hands already reaching. The bread does not keep its heat by staying whole.

obraz: The crack in the lava waits — you cannot cross it without a jump.
text: Thurisaz is the guard at the threshold, the caution that stands where one ground ends and another begins. Here it falls as the crack in the lava, black and open at your feet. You cannot walk across it, you can only jump or stay. The edge does not decide for you, it simply waits.

obraz: The shore returns one thing and keeps another with every wave.
text: The whole shore breathes at once, giving up driftwood and shell while it draws the sand back under. Gebo is that exchange, the giving and the taking held in one motion, nothing kept without something offered. Watch a single wave now, how it lays a stone at your feet and takes another. You stand at the tideline where both hands are open.

obraz: The squall strikes out of a clear sky and is gone just as fast.
text: Before the hail arrives, the sky above shows nothing of it. This is Hagalaz, Anna, the sudden force that breaks what stood and clears the ground beneath. The squall strikes hard, strips the grass, and is gone before you name it. What it changed underfoot stays changed long after the sky is blue again.

obraz: The rowan stands alone by the farmhouse and never bends all the way.
text: Look at the berries the wind stripped, still holding red on the low branch by the door. Eihwaz is the rune of what outlasts the hard season, roots deeper than the frost ever reaches. The rowan by the farmhouse leans in the gale but never goes all the way down, Anna. Are you bending now, or already holding your ground?

obraz: The cairn shows the way in the fog though no one stands by it.
text: The cairn holds its place in the fog, stones stacked by hands long gone, marking the way still. Algiz is that kind of shelter, the protection that stands whether or not you see who set it there. The path is not clear, but the next stone always is. You walk toward it now, Anna, and the one beyond it waits in the grey.

obraz: The guide-stone never tilts, whatever comes down on it.
text: The guide-stone stays upright while the storm strips the hillside around it, and the marks cut into its face hold true. Tiwaz is what does not bend when it would be easier to bend, the truth kept even at cost. Everything loose is being torn from the slope this season. What remains standing is what you meant.

obraz: The reflection in the still lagoon trembles at the least breath of wind.
text: Beneath the surface the lagoon holds its own depth, unseen until the water goes still. Mannaz is the rune of knowing yourself, of remembering who you are among others. The reflection there is clear one moment, then trembles at the least breath of wind. Is the face you see in it steady now, or moving?

obraz: The old farmstead stands in ruins but still holds warmth in memory.
text: Grass grows up through the fallen turf roof, and the old stones still mark where the hearth once stood. Othila is what comes down to you through kin and home, and what of it you carry on. The walls have gone back to the ground, yet the warmth of that room is not forgotten. You are standing in the ruin, in the place that made you.

obraz: Everything is still before what is to come — everything is still possible.
text: The lake lies flat at dawn, Anna, the sky doubled in it, the far shore and the near one both holding still. Blank is the rune of the not-yet, the open ground before anything has taken its shape. Watch long enough and one ripple crosses the whole surface. You are standing at the water's edge before the first stone falls.

obraz: The low winter sun plays for a moment on the white snowdrift and is gone again.
text: Sowilo is the sun's own will, the life force that reaches upward and does not ask permission. The low winter light catches the white snowdrift, and for a moment the whole ridge burns gold. Then it slides off, Anna, and the snow is plain white again. Was that a thing gained, or a thing merely shown to you?

obraz: The candle keeps the room alive while the midwinter dark lies over everything.
text: You sit in the one lit corner while the midwinter dark presses against the glass. Berkana is the birch that begins again, small growth kept alive in the coldest month. The candle holds this room, Anna, and you are the one tending its light.

obraz: The breeze carries the plover's call across the moor to you.
text: Before you see the bird, the sound of it reaches you across the moor. Ansuz is the word carried on air, the wisdom that arrives before you can name its source. The plover's call is thin and clear, and it finds you though the bird stays hidden in the heather. Is there something calling to you now, or is the moor still quiet?

obraz: The hands remember the work though the mind has forgotten it.
text: The workshop is lit and full, Anna, the tools laid out, the fire steady, the shape half-formed in your grip. Kenaz is that torch, the flame that shows what you can make. Let the rest go dim; watch only your hands. They move through the old work while your mind stands back, and you are already at the bench, holding it.

obraz: The sun finally reaches into the valley and everything goes still.
text: The valley wall stays exactly where it is while the light climbs over it and fills the low ground. Wunjo is the plain gladness of things sitting right, warmth arriving where it was cold. The grass stops moving, the air holds, and the whole slope goes still under the sun. That stillness has your name in it, Anna.

obraz: You keep knitting though the yarn is almost out.
text: Where the last of the yarn feeds into the needles, one thing turns into another, and there is not much left behind it. Nauthiz is the rune of need, of working from what little the roots still hold. Your hands know the row is nearly out, yet they keep the rhythm going. What are you finishing that the thread was never long enough to reach?

obraz: The bread comes hot from the oven, enough for everyone at the table.
text: The table stays where it is while the bread cools and hands reach across it. Fehu is wealth that means something only when it is shared, the loaf that feeds more than the one who baked it. What at your table is meant to be passed, and what are you holding back?

obraz: The crack in the lava waits — you cannot cross it without a jump.
text: The far edge holds firm while the ground at your feet gives way. Thurisaz is the threshold that will not be talked across, the fire in the rock that waits for a jump, not a step. The crack stays open, Anna, until you leave the ground.

obraz: The shore returns one thing and keeps another with every wave.
text: There, a single wet pebble left glinting where the last wave pulled back. Gebo is the give and take between you and what meets you, one thing arriving as another slips away. The shore keeps nothing for long, and it never stops offering. What comes to your hand today was carried here by the same water that took something else.

obraz: The squall strikes out of a clear sky and is gone just as fast.
text: Below the calm water, the current has already turned. Hagalaz is the sudden break, the squall that strikes from a clear sky and is gone before you name it, leaving the roots stirred. What was moving down there before the sky went dark?

obraz: The rowan stands alone by the farmhouse and never bends all the way.
text: The rowan by the farmhouse leans in the wind and holds, its roots gripping ground you cannot see. Eihwaz is that hidden strength, the part of you that bends without breaking. What down there is keeping you standing, and do you even know its name?

obraz: The cairn shows the way in the fog though no one stands by it.
text: Behind the fog the whole line of cairns waits, each one built by a hand long gone. Algiz is protection that stands where no guard stands, the marker someone left so the way could be found again. The stones do not call out, they simply hold their place in the grey. Which is nearer to you now, the trusting of what you cannot yet see, or the wanting to see it first?

obraz: The guide-stone never tilts, whatever comes down on it.
text: The guide-stone stands at the ridge, wind and rain and the weight of years coming down on it, and it does not tilt. Tiwaz is the sense of what is fair holding its line while everything leans against it. Where would you stand if nothing came to hold you up?

obraz: The reflection in the still lagoon trembles at the least breath of wind.
text: Where the water meets the still air, your own face looks back at you from the lagoon. Mannaz is the seeing of yourself as you are, and even one breath of wind sets that reflection trembling. It settles again, and the face is still there.

obraz: The old farmstead stands in ruins but still holds warmth in memory.
text: The hearthstone stands where the walls have fallen, still dark from the fires it once held. Othila is what you inherit and carry forward, the line of hands that came before yours. The turf roof is gone, but the stone keeps the shape of the warmth. Which of these old stones do you still count as yours, and which have you set down?

obraz: Everything is still before what is to come — everything is still possible.
text: The pool at the spring's source lies dark and unmoving, the whole valley held in its surface, every path still open. Then the wider picture falls away, and only the water remains. This is Blank, the rune of what has not yet taken shape, nothing written, everything still possible. The stillness stays a while longer before anything stirs.

obraz: The low winter sun plays for a moment on the white snowdrift and is gone again.
text: One crystal on the drift catches the low winter sun and flares white, then the light moves on. Sowilo is that reaching toward clarity, the moment a thing is lit and seen for what it is. You stand at the edge of the snow while the light passes over it.

obraz: The candle keeps the room alive while the midwinter dark lies over everything.
text: The room holds a table, a chair, the dark pressing at the window, and one candle burning. Berkana is the small tending that keeps something alive through the longest night. All of it falls away now but that steady flame, and the warmth it gives asks nothing back.

obraz: The breeze carries the plover's call across the moor to you.
text: The moor spreads open before you, wind moving through the low grass, cloud shifting overhead, the whole sky in motion. Then all of it falls quiet but one thread. Ansuz is the rune of the word that finds you, the plover's call carried on the breeze until it reaches your ear alone. You stand on the open moor, and the sound has already arrived.

obraz: The hands remember the work though the mind has forgotten it.
text: Where the woodwork begins, your hands find the grain before the mind knows the shape. Kenaz is that small light that works, Anna, the knowing that lives in the doing. You are already at the bench, tools warm in your grip.

obraz: The sun finally reaches into the valley and everything goes still.
text: Wunjo is the settling of things into ease, the moment scattered parts fall into one accord. Watch the light come over the ridge and slide down the slope until it reaches the valley floor. Where it touches, the wind drops and the grass stops moving. You are standing in that stillness, in the warmth that arrived without being called.

obraz: You keep knitting though the yarn is almost out.
text: Your needles keep moving, Anna, though the yarn thins to almost nothing in your hands. Nauthiz is the rune of need, of what grows only when the ground beneath it holds back. You knit on into the last of the thread, counting each stitch that remains. What are you making that you cannot stop to measure?

obraz: The bread comes hot from the oven, enough for everyone at the table.
text: The oven stays warm long after the fire has burned down, Anna, and the bread comes from it hot enough for every seat at the table. Fehu is that warmth held in the stone, the kind of wealth that feeds more than the one who made it. The loaf is broken and passed, and no hand leaves the table empty. What is earned here does not stay in a single pair of hands.

obraz: The crack in the lava waits — you cannot cross it without a jump.
text: The lava field opens before you, black and split by a crack too wide to walk across. Thurisaz is that crack, the raw edge where standing still is no longer standing but waiting. You cannot ease over it, Anna, only jump or stay.

obraz: The shore returns one thing and keeps another with every wave.
text: The wave slides up the sand, sets down a strand of kelp, and draws a smooth stone back under. Gebo is that exchange, the giving and the taking that arrive in the same motion. Nothing is only kept and nothing is only lost here. What would you have the water carry off, and what would you have it leave?

obraz: The squall strikes out of a clear sky and is gone just as fast.
text: Hagalaz is the sudden hail that breaks from a clear sky, a disruption from below no one saw coming. It strikes the ground, it is gone, and what it struck lies bare. What it uncovered in you stays there, Anna, long after the sky cleared.

obraz: The rowan stands alone by the farmhouse and never bends all the way.
text: You stand by the rowan at the corner of the farmhouse, the one tree that never bends the whole way down. Eihwaz is that holding, Anna, the wood that gives to the wind and stays rooted at once. Its strength is not in standing stiff but in the deep pull of what lies beneath the ground. The rowan keeps its place, and the wind moves on.

obraz: The cairn shows the way in the fog though no one stands by it.
text: The cairn holds its place while the fog moves past it, unbothered, going nowhere. Algiz is that stone stacked by hands long gone, still marking the way when everything around it has thinned to grey. What guards you does not need to be seen to hold.

obraz: The guide-stone never tilts, whatever comes down on it.
text: The guide-stone stands where the paths meet, Anna, snow on it, sun on it, boots and hooves passing, and it never tilts. Tiwaz is that stone, the fixed sense of what is fair that holds while everything leans against it. What weight are you letting decide which way you point?

obraz: The reflection in the still lagoon trembles at the least breath of wind.
text: Below the surface the water holds still, dark and untroubled by anything above. Mannaz is that seeing of yourself, the face the lagoon gives back when the air lies quiet. But the least breath crosses it, and the reflection shivers into pieces. When the wind touches you, Anna, does your sense of who you are hold, or scatter?

obraz: The old farmstead stands in ruins but still holds warmth in memory.
text: A single iron nail still holds in the fallen doorframe, keeping its grip long after the roof came down. Othila is what those before you built and left standing in you, the shape their hands pressed into the ground here. What they made does not vanish because the walls did.

obraz: Everything is still before what is to come — everything is still possible.
text: Beneath the still dark water, nothing has taken its shape yet, and the roots wait in the cold for a signal that has not come. The Blank rune is that held breath before the first stirring, when everything is possible because nothing is decided. What sits below the surface is heavy, quiet, and yours alone. You stand at the water's edge, before the light reaches the bottom.

obraz: The low winter sun plays for a moment on the white snowdrift and is gone again.
text: You are standing where the low winter sun breaks across the white drift, catching it bright for one breath before it slides behind the ridge. Sowilo is that light, Anna, the clarity that comes not to stay but to show you the ground while it lasts. You saw the shape of things plainly in that moment. Does what the light showed still hold now that the drift has gone grey again, or has it slipped from you?

obraz: The candle keeps the room alive while the midwinter dark lies over everything.
text: Where the candlelight ends the midwinter dark begins, and the small flame keeps the room warm and living all the same. Berkana is that tending, Anna, the care that holds a life through the longest night. What you keep alight now, keeps you.

obraz: The breeze carries the plover's call across the moor to you.
text: The breeze lifts the plover's call across the moor and lays it at your feet, Anna. Ansuz is that carried sound, a word finding its way to the one who can hear it. The bird is far off, yet the message arrives whole. Somewhere a voice is already moving toward you across the open ground.

obraz: The hands remember the work though the mind has forgotten it.
text: There is a small callus on the side of your finger, worn smooth by a task the mind has stopped naming. Kenaz is that steady light in the hands, the knowing that stays lit when memory goes dark. The work remembers itself through you.

obraz: The sun finally reaches into the valley and everything goes still.
text: You are standing in the valley when the sun finally reaches down and everything goes still, the grass warm underfoot, the air holding. Wunjo is that stillness, Anna, the moment things fall into place and nothing pulls against you. It asks nothing of you, only that you notice it while it lasts. You are here, in the light that reached the valley floor.

obraz: You keep knitting though the yarn is almost out.
text: The last of the yarn thins to almost nothing, Anna, yet your hands keep the rhythm going. Nauthiz is that stubborn work at the edge of what you have, where need itself teaches the stitch. What you make now is shaped by the shortage, not despite it.

obraz: Brauðið kemur heitt út úr ofninum, nóg handa öllum við borðið.
text: Áður en brauðið kemur úr ofninum vinnur gerið í deiginu, hljótt og óséð. Fehu er þessi gnægð sem á sér stað löngu áður en hún sést á borðinu. Þú finnur ilminn breiðast um húsið, heitan og nógan handa öllum. Þú stendur við ofninn og bíður eftir að hleypa hitanum út.

obraz: Sprungan í hrauninu bíður — þú kemst ekki yfir nema stökkva.
text: Þar sem hraunið endar, Anna, opnast sprungan svört og djúp. Þurs stendur við þennan jaðar, þar sem gamalt land brotnar og annað tekur við. Þú kemst ekki yfir gangandi, aðeins með stökki. Fjærbrúnin bíður köld og kyrr, og enginn hleypur hana fyrir þig.

obraz: Fjaran skilar einu og hirðir annað með hverri báru.
text: Sandurinn liggur kyrr, Anna, meðan bárurnar skila einu og hirða annað. Gebo er þetta jafna spil, að gefa og þiggja í sömu hreyfingu. Þú stendur á þessum sanda og finnur hvað hafið réttir þér og hvað það tekur til baka. Er eitthvað sem þú ert tilbúið að láta báruna bera?

obraz: Élið skellur á úr heiðskíru og er farið jafn skjótt.
text: Eitt strá bognar undan haglinu og réttir sig svo aftur. Hagalaz er élið sem skellur á úr heiðskíru og er farið jafn skjótt, öflin sem þú stýrir ekki. Hvað í þér stóð eftir þegar hríðin var gengin hjá?

obraz: Reyniviðurinn stendur einn við bæinn og bognar aldrei alveg.
text: Rótin sem enginn sér heldur reyniviðnum við bæinn þótt vindurinn leggist á hann. Eihwaz er sú seigla sem býr neðanjarðar, Anna, það sem stendur af sér veðrin án þess að brotna. Þú stendur við þennan sama stofn, bogið en heilt.

obraz: Varðan vísar leiðina í þoku þótt enginn standi hjá.
text: Þar sem stígurinn hverfur í þokuna tekur varðan við, steinn ofan á steini. Algiz er þetta merki sem einhver hlóð svo sá næsti rataði heim. Enginn stendur hjá, samt vísar hún þér leið gegnum grámann. Finnur þú vörðuna sem heldur þér réttri, Anna?

obraz: Leiðarsteinninn hallast aldrei, hvað sem á dynur.
text: Þar sem vindurinn snýr laufinu stendur leiðarsteinninn kyrr, Anna, og hallast aldrei hvað sem á dynur. Tiwaz er sú rún sem heldur við eitt orð þótt allt hitt bogni. Þú sérð hann þarna á jaðrinum, óhreyfðan meðan grasið leggst flatt. Hvað í þér heldur velli þegar allt annað gefur eftir?

obraz: Spegilmyndin í lygnu lóninu bærist við minnsta blæ.
text: Eitt fiskiflugukorn snertir vatnið, og spegilmyndin í lóninu titrar. Mannaz sýnir þig eins og þú ert, þegar yfirborðið kyrrist á ný. Þú stendur við barminn og horfir í þína eigin mynd.

obraz: Gamli bærinn stendur í tóftum en heldur enn hita í minningunni.
text: Grjótið í tóftinni er kalt en veggirnir muna enn reykinn sem eitt sinn steig upp. Othila stendur fyrir arfinn sem þér var réttur, það sem þú berð frá gömlu heimili. Steinarnir liggja þar sem hendur löngu horfnar hlóðu þeim. Þú stendur á miðju gólfi þar sem enginn bær er lengur.

obraz: Allt er kyrrt á undan því sem gerist — enn er allt mögulegt.
text: Tjörnin liggur kyrr, Anna, áður en fyrsti dropinn snertir hana. Auða rúnin er þessi flötur þar sem ekkert er enn skrifað og allt getur enn orðið. Ertu tilbúið að láta hann vera ósnertan aðeins lengur?

obraz: Lága vetrarsólin leikur snöggvast á hvítri fönninni og hverfur aftur.
text: Þar sem fönnin mætir birtunni kviknar snöggt glit og deyr aftur. Sowilo er sá lífskraftur sem lýsir upp augnablik og teygir sig í víðari himin. Ljósið er stutt en það nær samt yfir alla brekkuna. Þú stendur í þessari lágu vetrarsól, opið fyrir því sem hún snertir.

obraz: Kertaljósið heldur lífi í stofunni meðan skammdegið liggur á öllu.
text: Litla loganum tekst að halda birtu í stofunni þótt myrkrið liggi þungt fyrir utan. Berkana er umhyggjan sem heldur lífi í einhverju smáu meðan allt annað dregur sig í hlé. Verndar þú þennan loga núna, Anna?

obraz: Andvarinn ber lóukvakið yfir móann til þín.
text: Andvarinn ber lóukvakið yfir móann til þín, hljóð sem berst lengra en þú sérð. Ansuz er boðið sem kemur að utan, orð eða merki sem leitar að eyra. Kvakið fyllir loftið hvort sem þú stendur kyrrt eða heldur áfram. Ertu tilbúið að heyra það sem berst til þín núna?

obraz: Hendurnar muna handtökin þótt hugurinn hafi gleymt þeim.
text: Kenaz er kyndillinn sem lýsir upp það sem þú kannt en manst ekki að þú kunnir. Hendurnar taka til starfa á meðan hugurinn hikar enn. Þær rata að handtökunum í myrkrinu, hljóðlega, án þess að spyrja leyfis.

obraz: Sólin nær loksins inn í dalinn og allt verður kyrrt.
text: Sólin læðist loksins inn í dalinn og allt verður kyrrt í hlýju hennar. Wunjo er þessi sátt sem sest að þegar þú þarft ekki lengur að streitast á móti. Þú stendur í birtunni og finnur hana hvíla á öxlunum.

obraz: Þú prjónar áfram þótt garnið sé við það að klárast.
text: Prjónarnir ganga áfram, garnhnykillinn minnkar, hendurnar vita ekki hvenær þær eiga að nema staðar. Nauthiz er þrýstingurinn sem lætur þig halda áfram þegar lítið er eftir. Allt hverfur nema þessi síðasti spotti sem rennur milli fingra þinna. Hvað ætlar þú að gera þegar hnykillinn þrýtur í miðju verki?

obraz: Brauðið kemur heitt út úr ofninum, nóg handa öllum við borðið.
text: Hnífurinn liggur við borðið, tilbúinn að skera. Brauðið kemur heitt úr ofninum, nóg handa öllum sem sitja hér. Þetta er Fehu, gnægðin sem vex þegar henni er deilt. Áttu nóg núna til að rétta öðrum sneið, Anna?

obraz: Sprungan í hrauninu bíður — þú kemst ekki yfir nema stökkva.
text: Sprungan klýfur hraunið, Anna, en brúnin hinum megin stendur föst meðan svörðurinn undir fótum þér molnar. Þar er Þurs, hliðið sem opnast aðeins með stökki, og ræturnar undir sjóða. Þú stendur á barminum með hælana í lausu grjóti. Ætlarðu að bíða þar til brúnin sem þú stendur á gefur sig sjálf?

obraz: Fjaran skilar einu og hirðir annað með hverri báru.
text: Þar sem báran mætir sandinum skilar hún einu skeljabroti og tekur annað með sér út. Þetta er Gebo, gjöfin sem aldrei stendur ein, því sérhvað sem berst að landi kallar á eitthvað á móti. Ertu tilbúið að taka við því sem báran réttir þér?

obraz: Élið skellur á úr heiðskíru og er farið jafn skjótt.
text: Steinninn stendur kyrr meðan élið lemur hann að ofan. Hagalaz er haglið sem fellur úr heiðum himni og er farið áður en þú nærð að skýla þér. Það bráðnar í svörðinn og skilur allt eftir blautt og bert. Hvað í þér stendur enn fast þegar élið er gengið hjá, Anna?

obraz: Reyniviðurinn stendur einn við bæinn og bognar aldrei alveg.
text: Vindurinn sveigir reyniviðinn við bæinn en hann réttir sig alltaf aftur, Anna. Eihwaz er þessi seigla, ræturnar sem halda þótt krónan svigni. Þú stendur við þennan stofn sem bognar en brotnar ekki.

obraz: Varðan vísar leiðina í þoku þótt enginn standi hjá.
text: Þar sem stígurinn hverfur í þokuna rís varðan úr grjótinu, hlaðin af höndum sem löngu eru farnar. Algiz er þessi varða, Anna, merkið sem vísar leið þótt enginn standi hjá. Treystir þú því sem bendir þér áfram þegar þú sérð ekki lengra?

obraz: Leiðarsteinninn hallast aldrei, hvað sem á dynur.
text: Vindurinn beygir hverja grein en leiðarsteinninn hallast aldrei, hvað sem á dynur. Þetta er Tiwaz, sannleikurinn sem heldur línu sinni þegar allt annað lætur undan. Þú veist nú þegar hvað í þér stendur kyrrt.

obraz: Spegilmyndin í lygnu lóninu bærist við minnsta blæ.
text: Þú stendur við lygnt lónið, Anna, og hallar þér yfir barminn til að sjá andlitið þitt í vatninu. Mannaz er þessi spegilmynd, sjálfið sem horfir til baka á þig. Minnsti blær bærir flötinn — þekkirðu myndina þegar hún kyrrist aftur?

obraz: Gamli bærinn stendur í tóftum en heldur enn hita í minningunni.
text: Ein grasstrá stendur upp úr þúfunni þar sem eldstæðið var, Anna. Othila er þetta, arfurinn sem enn ornar þótt þakið sé fallið. Tóftin heldur laginu á húsinu löngu eftir að fólkið gekk burt. Þú stendur í dyrunum sem eru orðnar að steini og mosa.

obraz: Allt er kyrrt á undan því sem gerist — enn er allt mögulegt.
text: Vatnið liggur slétt við bakkann, þar sem einn dropi verður að straumi. Auða rúnin er þessi kyrrð á undan, Anna, þar sem ekkert er enn ráðið. Er eitthvað í þér sem er tilbúið að hreyfast?

obraz: Lága vetrarsólin leikur snöggvast á hvítri fönninni og hverfur aftur.
text: Þú stendur á fönninni þegar lága vetrarsólin leikur snöggvast á hvítunni og hverfur svo aftur. Sowilo er þessi sól, birtan sem nær til þín þótt hún dvelji stutt. Hún snertir það sem í þér vill vaxa, jafnvel á skemmsta degi ársins. Ljósið kemur aftur, eins og það hefur alltaf gert.

obraz: Kertaljósið heldur lífi í stofunni meðan skammdegið liggur á öllu.
text: Kertaljósið heldur lífi í stofunni meðan skammdegið liggur þungt á öllu úti. Nú hverfur allt nema þessi eini logi sem þú heldur við með höndunum. Berkana er björkin sem verndar það sem vex hægt í myrkrinu. Þú stendur við ljósið sem þér var treyst fyrir að gæta.

obraz: Andvarinn ber lóukvakið yfir móann til þín.
text: Þú stendur við móann, Anna, og andvarinn ber lóukvakið til þín yfir grasið. Ansuz er þetta hljóð sem berst að utan, orð sem finnur þig áður en þú leitar þess. Eitthvað í loftinu talar, og þú ert loksins kyrrt nóg til að heyra. Kvakið heldur áfram, hvort sem þú hlustar eða ekki.

obraz: Hendurnar muna handtökin þótt hugurinn hafi gleymt þeim.
text: Undir gleymskunni liggur kunnátta sem hefur ekki horfið. Kenaz er kyndillinn sem lýsir upp handtökin sem hendurnar muna þótt hugurinn hafi sleppt þeim. Þú þarft ekki að læra þetta upp á nýtt, glóðin logar enn.

obraz: Sólin nær loksins inn í dalinn og allt verður kyrrt.
text: Þar sem skuggi brúnarinnar sleppir takinu, Anna, nær sólin loksins inn í dalinn og allt verður kyrrt. Wunjo er þessi hlýja sem sest yfir grasið, sáttin sem kemur þegar ekkert þarf lengur að togast á. Þú stendur í birtunni þar sem dalurinn hljóðnar.

obraz: Þú prjónar áfram þótt garnið sé við það að klárast.
text: Þú prjónar áfram þótt hnykillinn sé nærri tómur, og hver lykkja togar fastar en sú síðasta. Þetta er Nauthiz, þrýstingurinn sem kemur þegar lítið er eftir og verkið heimtar samt sitt. Garnið þynnist milli fingra þinna, og þú finnur hvar það heldur og hvar það gefur eftir. Þarna, Anna, endar þráðurinn þar sem hann endar.
